side_idle.action: stable three-quarter side idle facing screen-right; subtle breathing and one blink; feet planted and hands empty

side_walk.action: three-quarter side walk toward screen-right; two alternating foot contacts, compact stride, gentle arm counter-swing, continuous loop

side_sea_intake.action: three-quarter side salt-worker seawater intake cycle facing screen-right; lower a small wooden dipper bucket, scoop brine, lift it with both hands, return to ready pose; one connected handheld bucket only

side_kiln_work.action: three-quarter side salt-kiln tending cycle facing screen-right; lean toward an off-frame boiling pan, stir brine with one short wooden paddle, straighten slightly, return; paddle remains held and connected to the hands
